note: Which way each skinned game model's MESH faces in its own rest pose (+Z or -Z), read from raw rest renders (no animation, no rotation) seen from a camera on +Z: front visible = +Z, back visible = -Z. The game and the T3 retarget assume +Z; a -Z model is turned 180 deg at instance creation. Bone names/orientations are NOT trusted for this: the auto-rig template skeleton faces -Z and many +Z meshes carry it (Left* bones on the mesh's anatomical right). Unlisted models fall back to the feet-geometry cue in t3anims.js meshForward() when it is confident, else +Z.
method: game/poselab.html window.__poselab.rest(model) via headless Chromium; contact sheets viewed by Claude 2026-10-20

corrections.nightwolf: 2026-10-22: REVERTED the -Z correction from earlier the same day. Direct raw-GLB render (three.js, camera on +Z, no instance correction) shows her FRONT from +Z and her BACK from -Z: the mesh faces +Z. The -Z reading came from a per-part audit that transforms mesh verts by the rig's bone matrices; nightwolf's auto-rig skeleton faces -Z inside her +Z mesh, which flips that measurement. The game corrects by MESH facing, so +Z (no turn) is correct. Proof: worker-5 raw renders.
